task: MR05 补测：恢复区展示「旧版本 → 新版本」（A14）
closes: gap-register A14 (sidecar version/change display in the recovery area)
dataSource: The sidecar is <mod>.mcmini.json shaped like ModInstallMetadata with a versionNumber field. A replace quarantines the OLD sidecar (reason mod-replace, base dir = mods) so the old version is readable from the recovery area; the new version is readable from the live sidecar.

implementation.backend: GET /api/instances/{id}/recovery now returns oldVersion and newVersion. ReadSidecarVersion picks the right base directory per reason (mod-replace -> <gameDir>/mods, otherwise <gameDir>) and returns null on any failure so display data can never break the listing.
implementation.frontend: openRecoveryPanel renders a version: old -> new line for replace records; i18n adds recovery.versions and recovery.unknownVersion in both zh and en.

newFinding: A22 - the /mods/{file}/replace endpoint parses only newFileBase64 and expectedSha256 and passes version null to ReplaceAsync, so an API-driven replace NEVER writes the new sidecar and newVersion stays null. The UI can only ever show half of old -> new for API-driven replaces. Suggested fix: accept an optional version object in the replace body and pass it through, matching the install flow WriteOnlineMetadata.
